title: Basis of the exterior powers of a finite free module
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $r\ge0$, and $E$ a free $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-free-module] with basis $e_1,\dots,e_r$. For every $n\ge0$ the exterior power $\wedge^n_R(E)$ [def-weil-pbc-exterior-algebra] is a free $R$-module with basis the elements $e_{i_1}\wedge\dots\wedge e_{i_n}$, $1\le i_1<\dots<i_n\le r$; in particular it is free of rank $\binom rn$, $\wedge^n_R(E)=0$ for $n>r$, $\wedge^0_R(E)=R\cdot1\cong R$ (via $a\cdot1\mapsto a$) and $\iota:E\to\wedge^1_R(E)$ is an isomorphism.
